dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: Premium website production still depends on operator-run controlled proofs and rapid incident diagnosis; the new direct/hybrid creative path is bench-only and has not yet demonstrated unattended convergence.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: The latest proof cycle continued to expose production-only budget, prompt, truth, asset, build-loop and scoring defects quickly enough that repairs remain part of normal progress rather than exceptional maintenance.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The purchase-to-billing chain is implemented, but there is still no clean paid external end-to-end completion and the premium deliverable has not proven repeatable unattended quality.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: A persistent direct builder materially outperformed the decomposed pipeline, but it still peaked at 7.80 and then edited backward; candidate preservation and stop logic are newly merged rather than production-proven.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: Repeated decomposed-pipeline proofs plateaued around 6.2-7.3 and the better direct/hybrid architecture is not wired into production; premium 9.5+/10 unattended completion remains unproven.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: Offer, checkout, activation, entitlement, reporting and billing are credible, but the core premium deliverable is still under creative-architecture redesign and has no paying-customer proof.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable acquisition or lead-to-paid conversion loop is proven, and the public company still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property retired.

changed: The single biggest change is that the premium Website Builder's blocker is now better diagnosed but more fundamental than yesterday's wake bug: repeated controlled proofs of the decomposed creative pipeline plateaued around 6.2-7.3 regardless of implementer, while a persistent direct builder reached 7.80 before editing itself backward. Main now contains a bench-only hybrid architecture with one creative owner, screenshot feedback, immutable candidates and constraint-aware scoring, but it is not production-wired and has not yet produced repeatable premium unattended output. That improves the technical path forward while lowering current autonomy and commercial confidence.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 13-14 main-branch controlled-proof evidence and merges through PR #161, green latest Railway status, generated CURRENT_STATE proof of the full fulfillment/activation/billing chain, the direct/hybrid builder experiment and score outcomes, the current public no-customer disclosure, parked venture portfolio, and absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
